Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create a completely new fictional editorial healthcare photograph from this text description. No reference images.
Photographic treatment: the convincing look of a full-frame DSLR with a 50 mm prime lens at f/5.6, ISO 100, gentle window daylight and a white reflector. A real candid moment, believable lens perspective, coherent directional lighting, natural skin pores and fine hair, real woven fabric, lifelike eyes and hands. Keep the faces on one focal plane with enough depth of field to resolve all the people. Neutral white balance, restrained saturation, smooth continuous color and soft shadow transitions. Clean optical detail with no digital sharpening, HDR effect, clarity effect, beauty retouching, painted surfaces, wavy halos, contour bands, ringing, artificial blur cutouts, or plastic skin.
Composition: landscape 2:1 website hero photograph. The left 40 percent is an ordinary softly lit cream wall with subtle physical texture, quiet enough to hold a website headline. Family and clinician sit naturally close together on the right 60 percent; keep every face, the child's body, and the phone inside the frame. Eye-level camera, medium-wide scene with breathing room above heads. The scene should feel observed and human rather than posed for an advertisement.
Setting: a welcoming real healthcare room with cream walls, pale wood, muted sage textiles and sparse believable furnishings. No readable signs or visible text. Include one normal-sized iPhone lying screen-down on the bedding within easy reach, rear cameras visible, with a believable contact shadow. Phone is secondary to human connection. No recording graphics, overlays, watermark, medical procedures or additional people.

Moment: a cheerful routine checkup for a two-year-old East Asian toddler. The clothed toddler sits safely on an exam bed with their East Asian mother immediately beside them, a supportive arm around their back. Toddler holds a soft worn bunny toy and looks up at a Black woman pediatrician with short natural hair, sage scrubs and a stethoscope. The doctor leans forward slightly at the toddler's eye level with an easy, warm smile; mother smiles with affectionate relief. Capture curiosity, connection and a small shared moment of delight, with spontaneous expressions. Phone rests on the exam bed near the mother. Exactly three people including the toddler.
